address: 94-120 Charoen Muang Road, Wat Ket, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50000, Thailand
bio: This charming wooden building down a narrow alley has been serving delicious laab for years. The spicy minced buffalo meat and zesty cooked minced pork are sure to impress. With surprisingly affordable prices, this is a gem worth seeking out....
